summary: Add offline static Lean syntax highlighting to instruction excerpts and full source without altering Lean text.

examined.reason: Static lexical colors improve code reading; text and line anchors remain unchanged, and no network, JavaScript or third-party package is needed.
Presentation of code changes only; instruction section inventory, accepted forms and coverage claims are unchanged.

results.method: Documentation unittest suite; generated freshness check; Stratic validate; git diff --check; manual source-preservation script and browser screenshot/navigation
results.environment: System Python3 and in-app browser; static HTML generation; unchanged Lean source
results.evidence: Four documentation tests passed, 79 generated files current, Stratic valid and whitespace checks passed. Escaping/highlighting round trip preserves module source and nested-comment/string sample. Browser full-source navigation and screenshot confirm keyword, number and operator colors with line links intact. No Lean rebuild needed for this presentation-only change.
